title: vatica disticha
intro: Vatica disticha, commonly known as the Straight Borneo Beech, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Vatica disticha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Vatica disticha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
